name: EBpay
verdict: A crypto-payment wallet app for the EB coin. Its own site says it was founded with investment from a blockchain technology team and four major Southeast Asian internet groups, which it does not name. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Ownership is opaque - the site names no legal entity and ebpay.net was unreachable (HTTP 521) when checked 2026-09-28, so the claim rests on the site's own archived about text. No state owner appears anywhere in the site's own material.
